mustFix: BLOCKING-1: HitDetector missing isLate flag + Scorer hard-mode late penalty not implemented (PRD §5.1: hard+late >75% into window = Base×0.5)
BLOCKING-2: Scorer.calculateXP() ignores mode and speed — practice speed bonus dead code (PRD §5.5: >100% speed = +25% XP, >125% = +50% XP)
BLOCKING-3: notesTotal missing from GameState.RESETTABLE_FIELDS — corrupts accuracy calculation on song replay
optionalPolish: NoteScheduler: add speed<=0 guard to buildSchedule()
Scorer: wrap early penalty in mode==='standard' guard for clarity
HitDetector: return real accuracyMs delta for wrong-pitch hits
Performance: NoteScheduler cursor optimization (O(n) scan per frame)
followUps: Add tests: XP speed bonus at 1.01x, 1.26x, boundary 1.0/1.25

data.message: Feedback synthesized: 3 blockers from reviewer (hard late penalty, XP speed bonus, notesTotal reset). QA: 130/130 pass, clean build, no Phaser contamination. Sending repair brief to builder.

data.currentTask: Repair pass: fix 3 blockers from reviewer review of cp1

mustFix: HARD-MODE LATE PENALTY NOT IMPLEMENTED: PRD §5.1 requires hard-mode late hits (>75% into window) to score Base × 0.5. Currently no `isLate` flag in HitDetector and Scorer ignores mode.
PRACTICE-MODE XP SPEED BONUS NOT IMPLEMENTED: PRD §5.5 requires XP multipliers for speed >100% (1.25×) and >125% (1.5×) in Practice mode. XP.SPEED_BONUS_THRESHOLDS constants exist but are unused.

`notesTotal` NOT RESET: GameState.reset() does not include `notesTotal` in RESETTABLE_FIELDS, causing accuracy/grade corruption on multi-song sessions (notesHit=0 but notesTotal=stale previous value).
optionalPolish: NoteScheduler O(n) full scan per frame - tracked for performance work
HitDetector discards accuracyMs for wrong-pitch hits
Early penalty lacks explicit mode check despite being mode-specific
Missing test coverage for edge cases
followUps: Add `isLate` flag to GradeResult in HitDetector.ts
Thread isLate through to Scorer.calculatePoints(), implement hard-mode late penalty
Implement XP speed bonus in Scorer.calculateXP()
Add tests for all blocking items
